units.source_text: 是呵，要是对女人说说这些风景的事也许会好一点吧……

en.t: Yes, perhaps it would have been better if I had told the woman about these landscapes...

units.source_text: 该给她听绝对无法通用往返车票的“沙之歌”，

en.t: I should have let her hear the Song of the Sand, where a round-trip ticket could never possibly be used,

units.source_text: 即使音程多少有些紊乱也没关系……

en.t: even if the pitch was somewhat out of tune...

units.source_text: 而我做过的事，充其量是以别的生活为诱饵，

en.t: But what I had done, at best, was to use another life as bait,

units.source_text: 吊女人上钩而已，不过是模仿蹩脚色情演员的卑劣行径。

en.t: merely to lure the woman in, nothing more than the vile behavior of imitating a third-rate pornographic actor.

units.source_text: 连精神都不放过，就像鼻子尖被摁到了沙壁里面，套上纸袋的猫。

en.t: It did not even spare the spirit, like a cat with its nose pressed into a wall of sand and a paper bag pulled over its head.
